2WireGroundingGuide.title: 2-Wire Grounding Guide
2WireGroundingGuide.description:
A field guide to grounding Rain Bird's two-wire irrigation systems. This project compressed multiple discrete grounding documents into a single clear guide which explains how to protect the decoder systems from lightning and power surges.

**What we made**
Doran Design Studio conducted comprehensive research on grounding strategies, standard system designs, and environmental factors that influence their selection. To illustrate the various configurations, we created a set of isometric system drawings that effectively convey all the essential information in a single illustration, eliminating the need for multiple separate plan elevations that were previously employed. Each illustration is meticulously drawn on the studio’s grid and versioned in Graffold alongside the source files from which it originated.

FG100 Documentation.title: FG100 Documentation
FG100 Documentation.description:
A comprehensive documentation package has been prepared to support the launch of Rain Bird’s FG100 flow sensor. A Cinema4D rig was employed to render the product in various recommended configurations, including valves and master valves. The primary objective of this project was to introduce flow sensing to a new audience that had previously associated it with complex commercial-grade components. To achieve this, user-friendly first-person perspective rendered illustrations were created using Cinema4D, as technical drawings were deemed unsuitable for the target audience.

Doran Design Studio conducted research, mapped the new product in the wider product system to determine what content needed to be authored, then wrote and illustrated componentized content for multi-platform distribution.

Proactive Remote Management.title: Proactive Remote Management
Proactive Remote Management.description:
A set of documents that helps landscape contractors get their organisation running on Rain Bird's IQ remote-management platform. The printed companion that walks a crew from first login to a fully configured account.

**What we made** — An illustrated guide for contractors looking to add Proactive Remote Management to their business offering. The guide explains the business case and how they can get started. Also a guide for getting set up with the software and how permissions can be managed for teams. 

The package Doran Design delivered included technical and marketing copy, step-by-step diagrams, extensive illustration with versions created and managed in our proprietary Graffold system, allowing for asset re-use, multi-platform delivery, and version control of the source assets it's built from.
